s: chỉ số đánh giá hiệu quả (KPI); chỉ số đo lường hiệu quả (KPI)
a measurable value showing progress toward a goal
key performance indicator.e: Customer satisfaction is a key performance indicator for the team.

s: a word or phrase people type into a search engine
keyword.e: We chose the keyword cheap flights for our travel campaign.

s: a plastic card used to open a hotel room door
key card.e: Insert the key card into the slot to turn on the lights.

s: informal phrase meaning slightly or in some way
kind of.e: The film was kind of slow at first, but the ending was great.

s: to stay healthy and strong by exercising
keep fit.e: I go swimming twice a week to keep fit.

keep in touch.e: I keep in touch with my school friends through a group chat.

s: to go down onto your knees
kneel down.e: A gardener is kneeling down to plant some flowers.

s: the main speaker at a conference
keynote speaker.e: Our keynote speaker this morning is a well-known economist.

s: the relationship between members of the same family
kinship.e: In many small societies, kinship determines who you are allowed to marry.

s: Thân ái / Trân trọng (kết thư bán trang trọng)
(semi-formal) a polite way to end a letter or email to someone you know a little
kind regards.e: See you at the meeting on Friday. Kind regards, Sam

s: Nhớ cập nhật tin cho mình nhé
(informal) used to ask someone to tell you any news about a situation
keep me posted.e: Good luck with the house move, and keep me posted!
y: Let me know how it goes

s: one of two organs that remove waste from the blood
kidney.e: The kidneys clean the blood and remove waste from the body.

s: to have knowledge of things in your mind
know.e: Do you know the answer to question five?

kind.e: What kind of music do you like?

s: to have and continue to hold something
keep.e: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.

kid.e: The kids are playing in the garden.

s: to end the life of a person or other living thing
kill.e: Too much sun can kill young plants.

knowledge.e: She has a good knowledge of local history.

s: something you use to open a lock or start a car
key.e: I can't find my house key.

kitchen.e: We eat breakfast in the kitchen.

s: to put your lips against another's to show love
to hit someone or something using your foot
kick.e: He kicked the ball into the net.

s: to hit something to get people's attention
the male ruler of a country that has a royal family
king.e: The king lived in a huge palace.

s: the middle part of your leg that bends
knee.e: She hurt her knee while running.

s: being eager or excited for something to happen
keen.e: He is keen to learn more about photography.

s: long piece of metal you use for cutting things
knife.e: Use a sharp knife to cut the bread.

s: to stay at the same level or speed as someone or something
keep up with.e: It's hard to keep up with the latest technology because it changes so fast.

s: to watch or look after someone or something
keep an eye on.e: Could you keep an eye on my bag while I grab a coffee?
c: keep an eye on the kids

s: hiểu biết rộng; hiểu biết nhiều
knowing a lot about a subject
knowledgeable.e: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about local history.

s: the set of keys used to type on a computer
keyboard.e: My keyboard stopped working this morning, so I called IT support.

s: a unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters
kilometer.e: The hotel is two kilometers from the airport.

s: a set of tools or items for a purpose
kit.e: There is a first-aid kit in every office.

s: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams
kilogram.e: Each passenger may check one bag up to 23 kilograms.
